symptoms: lever vibrates in your hand, bike feels jerky when slowing down
solution: Check if the brake disc is bent, make sure brake bolts are tight, and check for worn pads.

problem: Gas smell or leak under the bike
symptoms: strong fuel smell, wet spots under the engine or gas tank
solution: Check gas hoses for cracks or leaks, tighten hose clamps, and check rubber seals.

problem: Bike pulls to one side while riding
symptoms: you have to push constantly on the handlebars to keep going straight
solution: Check tire pressure on both wheels, make sure the rear wheel is aligned, and check front fork height.

problem: Horn is quiet or doesn't work
symptoms: makes a faint click or no sound at all when you press the button
solution: Check the horn fuse, look for rusty or loose wires, and turn the small tuning screw on the horn.

symptoms: loud clunking noise over potholes, rear end feels bouncy or scrapes
solution: Stiffen the rear spring setting, add fork oil, or replace old shock absorbers.

problem: Turn signal flashes too fast or stays on
symptoms: blinker lights up without blinking or flashes super fast
solution: Replace any burnt-out bulb, check for correct bulb type, or change the blinker relay.

symptoms: popping or cracking noises coming from the pipe when you let go of the gas
solution: Check exhaust pipe joint gaskets for air leaks, and make sure air intake rubber boots are tight.

symptoms: speed needle stays at zero while moving, odometer stops counting distance
solution: Check the speedometer cable for breaks, check the wheel sensor wire, or replace the wheel gear.

problem: Rear wheel feels wobbly in turns
symptoms: back end feels loose or sways side to side in corners
solution: Tighten the main axle bolt, check for loose swingarm bolts, and inspect wheel bearings for play.

symptoms: jerking, loss of power, or choking feeling when you twist the throttle all the way
solution: Clean dirty fuel injectors or carburetor jets, check spark plug caps, and replace old fuel.

symptoms: gas handle doesn't spring back automatically when released, stays revved up
solution: Oil the throttle cables, clean dirt inside the handle housing, and check for rubbing grip rubber.

problem: Starter makes whirring noise but engine won't turn over
symptoms: high spinning sound when pressing start button, but engine does not crank
solution: Inspect or replace the starter clutch gear that hooks up to the engine.

symptoms: dark oil spots under the engine, low oil line on sight glass or dipstick
solution: Replace the drain plug washer, tighten loose engine cover bolts, and check rubber gaskets.

problem: Oil leaking down the front forks
symptoms: shiny oil rings on front fork tubes, oil getting onto front brakes
solution: Wipe dirt off the fork tubes, use a seal cleaner tool, or replace leaking fork rubber seals.

problem: Scooter revs high but accelerates slowly
symptoms: engine roars loudly, high-pitched belt squeal, slow speed pickup
solution: Check the rubber belt inside the belt box for wear, clean dust out of the clutch, and check roller weights.
